policies.name: Block Beta OS Versions
policies.description: Blocks enrollment in Apple beta OS programs and removes devices from any beta seed they are already on (Software Update Program Enrollment = AlwaysOff). No beta token required. Applies to supervised Macs on macOS 15.4+.

policies.name: DDM Passcode
policies.description: Enforces passcode requirements for macOS devices including minimum length, complexity, failed attempt limits, and expiration policies to ensure device security compliance.

policies.name: Edge macOS Level 1 Basic
policies.description: Enhanced basic browser configuration for Microsoft Edge addressing gap analysis findings (Certificate management, network policies, system integration)

policies.name: Energy
policies.description: Configures power management and energy saver settings for macOS devices. Sets display sleep to 5 minutes and system sleep to 10 minutes for both desktop (AC power) and portable devices. Enables Wake on LAN for desktop computers to allow network-based device management and remote wake capabilities.

policies.name: Entra Platform SSO
policies.description: Configures Platform Single Sign-On (SSO) for Microsoft Entra ID authentication on macOS devices, enabling seamless authentication across Microsoft services and applications.

policies.name: FDA - OneDrive

simpleSettingValue.value: identifier "com.microsoft.OneDrive" and anchor apple generic and certificate 1[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.2.6] /* exists */ and certificate leaf[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.1.13] /* exists */ and certificate leaf[subject.OU] = UBF8T346G9

policies.description: Grants OneDrive (com.microsoft.OneDrive) Full Disk Access (SystemPolicyAllFiles) via a Privacy Preferences Policy Control (PPPC) settings-catalog profile. Pre-approves OneDrive access to protected file locations so file sync works without per-user TCC consent prompts.

policies.name: FileVault Encryption
policies.description: Configures FileVault disk encryption on macOS devices during Setup Assistant with recovery key escrow to Microsoft Endpoint Manager for enterprise data protection.

policies.name: Firewall Configuration
policies.description: Enables macOS firewall and prevents users from accessing and modifying firewall settings through System Preferences, ensuring firewall configuration remains under IT control.

policies.name: Gatekeeper Security Configuration
policies.description: Comprehensive Gatekeeper and system policy configuration that enables security assessment for downloaded applications, allows identified developers, enables XProtect malware uploads, and prevents users from overriding security policies.

policies.name: Guest Account Security Configuration
policies.description: Disables guest account access to enhance security on managed macOS devices. Guest accounts can bypass security policies and provide unauthorized access to the system.

policies.name: macOS Baseline Compliance Policy
policies.description: Baseline macOS compliance policy requiring FileVault encryption, Firewall enabled, SIP enabled, and minimum macOS 15.0. Gatekeeper configuration is handled separately via configuration policy.

policies.name: macOS Enrollment Restriction
policies.description: Controls macOS device enrollment settings and restrictions for managed devices.

policies.name: POL-APP-101 - Company Portal Privacy Preferences (PPPC)
policies.key: pol app 101 company portal privacy preferences (pppc)

simpleSettingValue.value: identifier "com.microsoft.CompanyPortalMac" and anchor apple generic and certificate 1[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.2.6] /* exists */ and certificate leaf[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.1.13] /* exists */ and certificate leaf[subject.OU] = UBF8T346G9

policies.description: Grants Company Portal (com.microsoft.CompanyPortalMac) App Management (SystemPolicyAppBundles) access via a Privacy Preferences Policy Control settings-catalog profile.

policies.name: Screensaver Security Configuration
policies.description: Configures comprehensive screensaver security settings including idle time activation (10 minutes), password requirements, delay timing, and login window idle timeout to enhance device security when unattended.
